value.rationale: The natural stationary far-tail observable in a bounded, dynamically heterogeneous diffusivity bath undergoes a sharp change in power-law prefactor at a physically controllable position-reset rate. Explicit asymptotic constants and the exact moment cutoff quantify rare excursions and distinguish bulk switching from edge-dominated transport, beyond the known fixed-time SCGF eigenvalue threshold.
